```{r}
#| label: load-packages
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```

```{r}
#| label: load-data
olympics_full <- read_csv("olympics.csv")
```

```{r}
#| label: prep-data
olympics <- olympics_full |>
  filter(
    season == "Summer",
    !is.na(medal)
  ) |>
  separate_wider_delim(
    cols = team, 
    names = c("team", "suffix"), 
    delim = "-", 
    too_many = "merge", 
    too_few = "align_start"
  ) |>
  select(-suffix) |>
  mutate(medal = fct_relevel(medal, "Bronze", "Silver", "Gold"))
```

## Row

### Column

## Medals by sport and year

### Medals by sport

```{r}
#| label: medals-by-sport
#| title: Medals by sport
olympics |>
  mutate(
    sport = fct_lump_n(sport, n = 15),
    sport = fct_infreq(sport),
    sport = fct_rev(sport)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(y = sport, fill = medal)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Medal"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +               
  theme(
    legend.position = "right"     
  )
```

### Medals by year

```{r}
#| label: medals-by-year
#| title: Medals by year

olympics |>
  count(year, medal) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = n, color = medal)) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = NULL,
    color = "Medal"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +                     
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom"    
  )
```

## Row

### Column

```{r}
most_gold <- olympics |>
  filter(medal == "Gold") |>
  count(team, sort = TRUE) |>
  slice_head(n = 1)

most_silver <- olympics |>
  filter(medal == "Silver") |>
  count(team, sort = TRUE) |>
  slice_head(n = 1)

most_bronze <- olympics |>
  filter(medal == "Bronze") |>
  count(team, sort = TRUE) |>
  slice_head(n = 1)
```

::: {.valuebox icon="award-fill" color="primary"}
Most Golds:

`{r} most_gold$n`
:::

::: {.valuebox icon="trophy" color="success"}
Most Silver:

`{r} most_silver$n`
:::

::: {.valuebox icon="award" color="danger"}
Most Bronze:

`{r} most_bronze$n`
:::

## Medals by country

::: panel-tabset
## Top 30 total medals

</br>

Teams sorted in descending order of total medals.

```{r}
#| label: top-30

olympics |>
  count(team, medal) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = medal,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  ) |>
  mutate(Total = Bronze + Gold + Silver) |>
  slice_max(n = 30, order_by = Gold) |>
  gt() |>
  data_color(
    columns = Gold,
    colors = scales::col_numeric(c("#FFF7CC", "#D4AF37"), domain = NULL)
  ) |>
  data_color(
    columns = Silver,
    colors = scales::col_numeric(c("#F2F2F2", "#C0C0C0"), domain = NULL)
  ) |>
  data_color(
    columns = Bronze,
    colors = scales::col_numeric(c("#F5E1D3", "#CD7F32"), domain = NULL)
  )
```

## Bottom 30 total medals

</br>

Teams sorted in descending order of total medals.

```{r}
#| label: bottom-30

olympics |>
```
